GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, held togetehr turn, Straightened Up half clear, headed 200m and weakened # led/faded
Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, held together turn, Straightened Up half clear, 1 length clear 200m, headed 100m, weakened final 50m # led/headed 100m
Jumped Ok took sit 4th fence 3 Lengths 800m 4th 3 Lengths home turn 2nd hit lead 300m kicked away to win with authority # good ride/class win
Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1-2l clear, 2 Lengths clear 200m, kept on strong to the line but swamped late # led/kicked/nailed
Jumped Well sat handy 1 length off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1 length off all clear, joined in 200m, took over 100m drew clear late # had run/too good
Jumped Ok sat 2 Lengths off 4 Wide No Cover , swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 3l off all clear, battled on well # 4 Wide trip
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. Raced very wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well , soon Drifted Back Two Wide 7th 5 Lengths @ 600m. on heels early Straight . again to 200m. Clear final stages, sound to line Just outbobbed for 3rd # solid once Clear
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Shifted in on jumping and made heavy contact with rnr. Raced keenly through the early stages. Near the 300m when attempting to obtain a tight run between rnrs laid in abruptly and when being corrected was disappointed for that run and then had to be shifted across heels clear running. When questioned regarding her riding out app. stated that she was mindful of her mount’s manners in the home straight & when approaching the winning post she received calling to her outside to which she stopped riding her mount having caution that her mount may shift in abruptly.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok faced breeze 1 length off, 2 Lengths off b4 turn sitting 3rd, eased 3 Wide turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, joined in approaching 200m b4 headed passing 200m, gave ground final 100m # weak final 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Change of tactics: to be ridden in a forward position – settled on pace.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair settled back 7l off, improved turn, Straightened Up 4-5l off, ran on well making good ground # back/ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that she anticipated her mount settling in a forward position, however, after beginning awkwardly from a wide barrier, her mount was obliged to settle towards the rear of the field.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ( Tongue Tie ) Jumped Well , Went Forward led on rail x 1 length but with riderless horse ahead of him. came out around that horse To The Turn and held 1-2L margin all of Straight # led/good kick
